Brand identity, design system, website

Brand, product and website from one team.

Each can be booked on its own. Booked together, they share one set of decisions, so nothing has to be redrawn later.

Brand identity

Name, logo, color, type and voice, packed into a system your team can use without calling us. Ends with a one-page guide.

Product design

Research, flows and interface for your first release. We design next to your engineers and hand over files they can build from.

Website

A fast, accessible site that says what you do on the first screen. Built in Webflow or in code, whichever suits your team.

Investor materials

A pitch deck and a one-page summary that tell your story in the order investors read it.

Eight weeks from first call to launch.

One fixed scope, a weekly review with your team, and no surprises on the invoice.

Week 1

Listen

We interview your team and a few customers, then write down what you stand for on one page.

Weeks 2 to 3

Decide

Three directions, one decision. You choose, and we refine until it holds up at every size.

Weeks 4 to 7

Build

Brand, product screens and website come together side by side, reviewed with you every week.

Week 8

Launch

We ship, hand over every file and guide, and stay on call for 30 days.

Questions founders ask first.

Who is Quarry for?

Pre-seed to Series A teams with a working idea and a founder who can make decisions quickly.

How is pricing set?

Every engagement has a fixed price, quoted after a 30-minute intro call. No hourly billing.

Can we book just one thing?

Yes. Brand, product design and website can each be booked on their own.

Do you work with our engineers?

Yes. We design alongside them and hand over Figma files and code-ready design tokens.

What happens after launch?

You get 30 days of support included. After that, you can book us by the month.

Tell us what you're building.

A 30-minute call. You leave with a clear next step, whether that's with us or not.
